name: Angular
shortDescription: Google's full-featured framework for building scalable web apps in TypeScript. Angular 22 brings signals, standalone components, zoneless change detection and server-side rendering out of the box.
highlights: Components, templates, control flow and signals
Routing, forms, HTTP and dependency injection
Testing, SSR, performance and project structure

name: React
shortDescription: The library that popularised component-based user interfaces. React 19 adds Actions, the use hook and Server Components on top of hooks and JSX.
highlights: Hooks, effects, context and data fetching

name: Vue.js
shortDescription: A progressive framework that is easy to adopt one page at a time. Vue 3's Composition API, reactivity system and single-file components scale from small widgets to full applications.
highlights: Composition API, Vue Router and Pinia

name: Svelte
shortDescription: A compiler-driven framework with no virtual DOM. Svelte 5's runes bring fine-grained reactivity with tiny bundles and very readable components.
highlights: SvelteKit routing, loading data and deployment

name: Next.js
shortDescription: The React framework for production. Next.js provides file-based routing, server rendering, React Server Components, route handlers and image optimisation.
highlights: The App Router, layouts and navigation
Server and client components, data fetching and caching
Route handlers, metadata, images and deployment

name: Nuxt.js
shortDescription: The Vue framework for universal applications. Nuxt 3 offers file-based routing, server-side rendering, auto-imports, data fetching composables and the Nitro server engine.
highlights: Data fetching, server routes and state
Modules, SEO, rendering modes and deployment

name: Remix
shortDescription: A web-standards-focused React framework, now merged into React Router, built around loaders, actions, nested routes and progressive enhancement.
highlights: Sessions, caching and deploying to any runtime

name: Astro
shortDescription: A content-first framework that ships zero JavaScript by default. Astro islands let you mix React, Vue or Svelte components into very fast static and server-rendered sites.

name: jQuery
shortDescription: The classic DOM manipulation and Ajax library. jQuery still runs on millions of sites; learn its API, plugins and how to migrate to modern vanilla JavaScript.
highlights: Plugins and migrating to plain JavaScript

name: Redux
shortDescription: Predictable state management for JavaScript applications. Learn the store, reducers and actions, then Redux Toolkit's modern, far less verbose patterns.
highlights: Redux Toolkit slices and RTK Query

name: NgRx
shortDescription: Reactive state management for Angular inspired by Redux. NgRx Store, Effects, Entity and the SignalStore help large applications stay predictable and testable.
highlights: Actions, reducers, selectors and the Store
Effects for side effects and Entity adapters

name: RxJS
shortDescription: Reactive programming with observables. RxJS composes asynchronous streams with operators and is built into Angular's HTTP client, router and forms.
highlights: Subjects, error handling and Angular integration

name: Zustand
shortDescription: A tiny, hook-based state manager for React. Zustand needs no boilerplate and no providers, and its stores work inside and outside components.

name: React Native
shortDescription: Build native iOS and Android apps with React. Learn the core components, navigation, styling, device APIs and the Expo toolchain.
highlights: Core components, styling and layout with Flexbox

name: Ionic
shortDescription: Cross-platform mobile UI with web technologies. Ionic pairs with Angular, React or Vue and ships to iOS, Android and the web through Capacitor.
highlights: Building and publishing to app stores

name: Electron
shortDescription: Desktop applications with HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Electron powers VS Code, Slack and Discord; learn the main and renderer processes, IPC and packaging.
highlights: Main process, renderer process and preload scripts
IPC, menus, dialogs and native integration

name: Three.js
shortDescription: 3D graphics in the browser with WebGL made approachable. Learn scenes, cameras, lights, materials, geometry, animation and loading 3D models.

name: D3.js
shortDescription: Data-driven documents: bind data to SVG and build custom, interactive visualisations with scales, axes, shapes, layouts and transitions.
highlights: Selections, data joins and SVG basics

name: Chart.js
shortDescription: Simple, responsive charts drawn on the HTML canvas. Chart.js covers bar, line, pie, radar and scatter charts with a small API and a plugin system.
highlights: Responsive charts, plugins and framework integration

name: GSAP
shortDescription: The GreenSock Animation Platform: professional-grade, high-performance animation for the web with tweens, timelines, ScrollTrigger and rich easing.
